test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Articles of the Constitution of India have laid down religious freedom, including the freedom to wear religious clothing?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Article 25-28__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Right to freedom of religion is well described in the Articles 25, 26, 27 and 28 of Indian constitution.
 
• **Article 25** gives every person the right to freedom of right to freely profess, practice, and propagate religion subject to public order, morality.
 
• **Freedom to present at religious instruction or religious worship in educational institutions**.
 
• **Article 27 **says that any citizen of India has a **Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The six fundamental rights include the**

 
 
• **​****Right to Equality.**
 
• **Right to freedom.**
 
• **Right against exploitation.**
 
• **Right to freedom of Religion, Cultural and Educational Rights.**
 
• **Right to constitutional Remedies**.
